description: Advisories accepted for now, each with why and until when (scripts/audit-report.mjs). An expired entry fails the audit.

entries.reason: Only Storybook's build and dev server use it, on our own source files; no untrusted input or AbortSignal reaches it, and nothing of it ships to browsers. npm's only suggested fix is a downgrade to Storybook 8.5, which would lose the accessibility addon set-up. Re-check when Storybook releases a fixed 9.x/10.x.
